title: The strongest cool core in REXCESS: Missing X-ray cavities in RXC J2014.8-2430
question: Why are bilateral X-ray cavities and radio bubbles missing in RXC J2014.8-2430 despite it being an extreme cool-core cluster hosting a powerful radio source, and how does sloshing affect the cool gas reservoir?

data.sensitivity: continuum: ~12 uJy RMS; line: ~6 mJy per 10 km/s channel

what.value: Optical spectroscopic redshift of BCG z = 0.1555 +/- 0.0003 and UV-based SFR of 8-14 M_sun/yr

evidence.quote: We use a more recent optical spectroscopic redshift, $z = 0.1555 \pm 0.0003$, obtained by (cite: 2010ApJ...715..881D), who fit for the H$\alpha$ emission from the BCG.
its minimum star formation rate, based on UV *XMM-Newton* optical monitor data uncorrected for dust extinction, is 8-14 M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$ (cite: 2010ApJ...715..881D).

what.value: Cluster mass M_500 = (6.0 +1.6/-1.3) x 10^14 M_sun from ACT SZ measurements

evidence.quote: we use the mass $M_{500}=(6.0\substack{+1.6\\-1.3}) \times 10^{14}~\rm M_\odot$ reported by (cite: Hilton2021) for this cluster using Sunyaev-Zeldovich (SZ; (cite: 1972CoASP...4..173S)) measurements from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT).

what.value: Galactic foreground column density N_H = 7.4 x 10^20 cm^-2

evidence.quote: For all spectral fits, the Galactic foreground extinction is fixed at N$_H$ = 7.4$\times 10^{20}$ cm$^{-2}$, the value reported in (cite: 1990ARAA..28..215D) for this region of the sky.

what.value: Archival radio flux densities from GLEAM, TGSS ADR1, WISH, Texas, RACS, NVSS, and VLASS

evidence.quote: We summarise in Table [1](#tbl:flux) the total flux measurements of the archival catalogues, including data from the GaLactic and Extragalactic All-sky Murchison Widefield Array (MWA) Survey (cite: 2017MNRAS.464.1146H)

what.value: 2MASS stars for WCS alignment and SDSS template galaxy spectrum SDSS J120028.87-000724.8

evidence.loc: SOAR H\alpha imaging and spectral observations
evidence.quote: The images were aligned to the world coordinate system (WCS) using stars from the Two Micron All Sky Survey (2MASS).

We estimated the redshift of the stellar emission by Fourier cross-correlating the continuum emission in RXC J2014.8-2430 to the spectrum of an elliptical galaxy SDSS J120028.87-000724.8 ($z = 0.0813\pm0.0002$).

recipe.goal: Image ALMA CO(1-0) spectral cube and continuum, and generate moment maps
recipe.method: Reimage calibrated ALMA visibilities using tclean to produce spectral datacubes at 30 km/s and 80 km/s resolution, and compute moment 0, 1, and 2 maps at reference frequency 99.759 GHz.
key_parameters: natural weighting; spectral resolution 30 km/s (and 80 km/s for channel maps); reference frequency 99.759 GHz
assumptions: z = 0.1555; no correction for beam smearing in moment maps

recipe.goal: Extract regional CO(1-0) spectra, fit velocity profiles, and derive molecular gas masses
recipe.method: Extract CO(1-0) spectra from four regions of interest (total detection, central BCG region, south-western spur, western spur), fit Gaussian profiles to the spectra, and convert CO luminosities to molecular gas masses.
key_parameters: Four regions of interest: total, central BCG, south-western spur, western spur
assumptions: CO-to-H2 conversion factor alpha_CO = M_mol / L_CO = 3.6 M_sun/L_sun

recipe.goal: Analyze Chandra X-ray surface brightness, thermodynamic profiles, AGN upper limits, and cavity toy model
recipe.method: Fit 2D elliptical profiles and 2D beta-model to 0.5-7.0 keV flux map, perform unsharp masking, extract spectra in contour and radial bins to fit MEKAL/MKCFLOW models in XSPEC and JACO, compute AGN point source upper limits with celldetect/aprates, and simulate 3D beta-model with empty spheres along the line of sight.
key_parameters: N_H = 7.4 x 10^20 cm^-2; min 2500 net counts per radial annulus; Gaussian smoothing 1 pixel (0.984'') and 10 pixels (9.84'') for unsharp mask
assumptions: Projected temperature approximately equal to deprojected temperature; cooling time threshold 7.7 x 10^9 yr; fully ionised plasma n = 2.3 n_H

recipe.goal: Measure H-alpha luminosity, optical emission-line kinematics, and BPT line ratios from SOAR data
recipe.method: Measure continuum-subtracted H-alpha+[NII] luminosity inside an 8'' aperture, extract 1D spectra in 3-pixel (0.45'') bins along the Goodman slit, fit Gaussian profiles and deblend H-alpha+[NII] using IRAF splot, and cross-correlate stellar continuum with an SDSS template using fxcor.
key_parameters: 8'' radius aperture for H-alpha photometry; 17 regions of 3 pixels (0.45'') each for spectroscopy; instrumental velocity width 294 km/s

recipe.goal: Measure low-frequency radio continuum fluxes, spectral index, and residual structures
recipe.method: Measure integrated flux densities from VLA 1.4 GHz, GMRT 610 MHz, and VLITE 338 MHz observations, combine with archival survey fluxes to determine the spectral index, and subtract a 2D Gaussian model from the GMRT image to inspect residuals.
key_parameters: 2D Gaussian model dimensions 6.8'' x 4.6'', PA 8.2 deg at 610 MHz; 92 GHz ALMA point excluded from spectral index fit
assumptions: Power law spectrum S proportional to nu^alpha

evidence.quote: We note that we have excluded the 92 GHz continuum data point provided by ALMA, which at 4.05 mJy $\pm 0.01$ mJy lies above the power law extrapolation.

rediscovery_reason: Single ALMA project (2018.1.00940.S) with public archival data and CDS cubes, clear quantitative targets (92 GHz continuum flux of 4.05 mJy, total molecular gas mass of 3.6e9 M_sun, bimodal CO velocity structure), and standard CASA tclean + Gaussian spectral fitting workflow.
